key_facts: For CASE CX130 (North America, catalog coverage 04/00–12/08), the inspected ESCO bucket assemblies list two bucket-tooth alternatives: 127558A1, quantity 4–6, in assembly 09-51 “BUCKETS - ESCO” (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/368E796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); and 233794A1, quantity 4–5, in assembly 09-52 “BUCKETS - ESCO” (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/6F27767B-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

127558A1 is paired with adapter 127557A1 and bucket-tooth key 233792A1; 233794A1 is paired with adapter 233793A1 and key 233795A1. The catalog presents these as separate bucket configurations, not confirmed interchangeable parts (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/368E796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/6F27767B-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The inspected bucket configurations cover 4-, 5-, and 6-tooth buckets with capacities from approximately 0.38 to 0.75 m³; the correct tooth depends on the installed bucket/configuration. Product links: 127558A1 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/attachments-buckets/bucket-teeth-parts/bucket-tooth/p/127558A1), 233794A1 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/attachments-buckets/bucket-teeth-parts/bucket-tooth/p/233794A1).

The local catalog is dated and machine coverage is partial; no serial/PIN-specific applicability was returned for the two tooth alternatives. Catalog quantities are not stock indications. Assembly evidence was observed 2026-11-04.
